title: Varanasi Movie Ratio Website
tagline: Cinematic aspect ratio explorer for films shot in Varanasi - a love letter to the city
description: An interactive visual essay exploring the aspect ratios of films shot in Varanasi. Features a curated database of 47 films, interactive ratio comparison tool, location mapping, and director interviews. Built as a personal passion project combining film history, data visualization, and the city's cinematic legacy.
problem: No centralized resource documents Varanasi's cinematic history. Film scholars and enthusiasts scatter across forums. Aspect ratio choices reveal directorial intent but are rarely analyzed in context of location.
solution: Editorial web experience: 1) Film database (Airtable → JSON) with metadata (ratio, year, director, locations, cinematographer), 2) Interactive ratio viewer: overlay any two films' frames synchronized by timeline, 3) Mapbox map with geotagged shooting locations + Street View, 4) Director/cinematographer interview carousel (original research), 5) Export: generate comparison images for social sharing. Static site (Astro) for performance.
architecture: Astro (static) + vanilla JS interactions: Data: Airtable (CMS) → build-time JSON → GitHub Actions deploy to Cloudflare Pages. Interactions: Canvas API for ratio overlay, IntersectionObserver for scroll reveals, Mapbox GL for locations. No backend. Lighthouse 100/100.
